answer: Every attestation carries a sequential delay. The txid seeds a verifiable delay function of 2^22 squarings, about 20 seconds on one core, and the steps cannot be split or farmed out because each one feeds the next. Fifty clones attesting eight transactions owe 400 proofs, 8,000 seconds of serial time per epoch, so forty rented cores buy them nothing; only waiting does, and the window shuts first. Verification costs one millisecond, so honest nodes pay little. A raven hoards across a whole grove but eats one nut at a time, and a ripple spreads from the single stone that hit the water.
